latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of How to Make Clips Video – AI-powered video clipping and export.

- Upload or describe your video; AI automatically creates trimmed clips with music, text, or transitions as requested.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (max 500MB). Handles TikTok-style vertical clips and other formats for creators.
- Fast cloud GPU pipeline: clips ready to download in 30-60 seconds.
- Handles user intents like upload, export, timeline status, and balance seamlessly via smart API routing.
- Automatic session & token management with support for anonymous use (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Clear error handling for common issues—file limits, plan status, and reconnect instructions.
